July/August 2015 UPDATE

New moderators:

Please welcome our two new moderators:

  • @Phuffu - Moderator of the Wiki (waiting for acceptance)

  • @ThatOneGuyOnFire - Moderator of the maps

Our new wiki is hosted at wikia:

On the wiki, you can find the Subverse Constitution, game mechanics, descriptions, but most importantly country profiles.

Every player will get their own page on the wiki based on what country they have, and they will be free to edit it and put content relating to /v/ModernPowers on it. On your own page, you may put statistics (army size, population, area of country etc.), conflicts, alliances, trade agreements, events, laws, other agreements etc. so your country can be distinguished from every other nation in the game.

If the mods see an event that is very notable, we may choose to put it on the events page of the wiki too. Every conflict will be listed on the wiki.

Changes to game mechanics:

  • We added more link flairs, see link flairs on the official wiki.

  • We added a date in the top right-hand corner of the subverse, just above the sidebar. Each day is equal to two months of /v/ModernPowers time (this makes one week equal to one year), where Monday is the exception. Monday is known as meta-day, see below.

  • The dates are as follows: Monday = Jan/Feb, Tuesday = Mar/Apr, Wednesday = May/Jun, Thursday = Jul/Aug, Friday = Sep/Oct, Saturday = Nov/Dec, Sunday = Meta-day.

Sunday is meta-day:

Sunday is known as meta-day, where you may only submit [Meta], [News] and [Roleplay]. You CANNOT submit any other type of post than them or it will be deleted. These posts should not affect the gameplay of the sub and should focus on discussion, recent summaries and descriptions of your country. [Claim] posts are always available to new users.

Possible CSS change:

We might soon be transferring from /v/Typogra (the theme /v/ModernPowers currently uses) to /v/Scribble, for the simplicity of the subverse.

IRC:

Our new IRC Channel is located on KiwiIRC. Join us for meta discussion!

EDIT: Sunday is now meta-day. The dates have been shifted accurately. See here for more information about the date.
